title: Foundations: Nu Metal - The Complete Guide
summary: What Nu Metal is, where it came from, and how its songs work.
body:
Nu Metal songs: Nu-metal fused metal with hip-hop: rapped verses, sung choruses, detuned 7-string riffs, and DJ scratches. It owned rock radio from 1998 to 2003.

History: Korn's 1994 debut invented it; Limp Bizkit, Linkin Park (Hybrid Theory, 2000 — 30 million sold), and Slipknot made it the biggest rock movement of the turn of the millennium.

How the songs work: Nu Metal favors the keys of Drop-D, Drop-C#. Common forms include Rapped verse, sung chorus, DJ breakdown; Quiet-loud dynamics with hip-hop beats. Players should master 7-string detuned riffs first, then turntable scratches as an instrument. Detuned; no capos.

title: In the End - Nu Metal Song Study
summary: Harmonic blueprint and playing guide for In the End by Linkin Park (2000).
body:
In the End — Linkin Park, 2000. The piano riff heard around the world.

HARMONIC BLUEPRINT (study chart, key of Drop-D):
D5 | A#5 | C5 | D5

This study chart uses the 'Rap-rock I–VI–VII' progression, the Nu Metal workhorse, to map how songs like this move. Form: rapped verse, sung chorus, dj breakdown. Listen for rapped verses over syncopated grooves — it is the fingerprint of the style.
